verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe agents running 'on a durable background queue' and a durable-execution framework that preserves progress across failures/restarts, which supports building autonomous background automations, but this is a developer framework capability requiring integration (Temporal/DBOS-style queues), not a built-in scheduler/trigger system for end users. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of an actual unattended background automation running end-to-end, built-in scheduling/triggering UI, and community confirmation of durable-queue usage in production.
